title: Owl silent flight — serrated feathers
problem_statement: Aircraft and fan noise limits operations near people. The problem is documented and scoped before any solution work begins.
concept: Owls fly silently thanks to serrated leading-edge feathers that break turbulence into smaller vortices. Researchers apply serrations to fan blades and airfoils to cut noise. Crossover note: the power here is the domain transfer — state explicitly what each domain contributes.
novelty_assessment: Noise reduction via leading-edge geometry rather than slower speeds.
validation_plan: Anechoic noise measurement vs smooth blades
